info.title: SmartGN Installation & Device Management API
info.description: Properties, supply points, external IoT installers, provisional and paid installations, versioned device associations and confirmed provisioning. IAM authorizes current delegated functions; Billing, Support and Monitoring remain separate services.

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: Versioned device associations and durable MQTT provisioning

get.summary: Get administrative data for an authorized supply point

put.summary: Update descriptive supply-point data without changing its meter identity
Update a property with an optimistic concurrency version

delete.summary: Deactivate a property while preserving its history

put.summary: Link a paid pending request to its customer's active supply point

post.summary: Apply a verified initial purchase idempotently

get.summary: List properties owned by the authenticated account

post.summary: Register a property owned by the authenticated account
Register a supply point in an active authorized property

post.description: Requires an administrative reason. Completed jobs and unexpired leases return 409. Attempts and original correlation are preserved.

get.summary: List external IoT installers as SuperAdmin

post.summary: Create a provisional request without creating an IAM account
Complete a confirmed installation exactly once
post.description: Requires the exact active association, confirmed provisioning and CONNECTED metadata with lastContact less than 30 seconds old and at most 5 seconds in the future. Missing or stale connectivity prevents completion. Replays preserve the completion date.

post.summary: Cancel an unfinished installation while preserving history
post.description: Requires SuperAdmin, current version and reason. If a device exists, revoke it first and wait for brokerConfirmed=true. Repeated cancellation is idempotent.

post.summary: Assign an enabled external IoT installer to a pending request

get.summary: Query a device by authorized supply point, or list devices as SuperAdmin
get.description: Telemetry supplies only operational connectivity and last transport contact. An unavailable dependency is explicitly marked UNAVAILABLE.

post.summary: Register an installed device and request provisioning
post.description: SuperAdmin only. Returns PENDING and a credential once; configure it and the association version on the physical device. Publication is enabled only after broker and Telemetry confirmations.

serviceAuth.description: Private service credential. Internal paths must remain outside public gateway routes.

bearerAuth.description: IAM JWT with issuer, smartgn-api audience, expiry and current account/session checks. Roles: USER, SUPERADMIN. Meter permissions are checked live.
